mapper.sql: m.id, m.user_id, m.material_name, m.stage, m.required, m.submitted, m.submit_date, m.attachment_name, m.note, m.rule_ref, m.created_by, m.created_at, m.updated_at, m.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.username) AS user_name, u.student_id AS student_no
FROM party_material m LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = m.user_id AND sp.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO party_material (user_id, material_name, stage, required, submitted, submit_date, attachment_name, note, rule_ref, created_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{materialName}, #{stage}, #{required}, #{submitted}, #{submitDate}, #{attachmentName}, #{note}, #{ruleRef}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE party_material SET material_name = #{material.materialName}, required = #{material.required}, submitted = #{material.submitted}, submit_date = #{material.submitDate}, attachment_name = #{material.attachmentName}, note = #{material.note}, rule_ref = #{material.ruleRef}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{material.id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE party_material SET submitted = #{submitted}, submit_date = #{submitDate}, attachment_name = #{attachmentName}, note = #{note}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT m.stage AS stage, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN m.submitted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS submitted_total FROM party_material m WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.stage ORDER BY m.stage
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM party_material m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.stage = #{stage} AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.submitted = 1
